howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple Process
howItWorks.description: Report a civic issue in minutes. We handle the rest — from assignment to resolution.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fill out a simple form with details, photos, and your location. Takes less than 2 minutes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI classifies and validates your complaint, assigns it to the right department automatically.
howItWorks.step3Desc: A field officer from the relevant department is assigned with a clear SLA deadline.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Get real-time SMS/WhatsApp updates as your issue progresses. View photo proof of resolution.

report.termsIntro: By submitting this complaint, you agree to the following terms and conditions:
report.term1Text: You confirm that all information provided in this complaint is true, accurate, and complete to the best of your knowledge. Providing false or misleading information may result in rejection of your complaint and potential legal consequences.
report.term2Text: Your personal information (name, mobile number) will be used solely for the purpose of processing and resolving your complaint. We will not share your contact details with third parties without your consent, except as required by law or for complaint resolution purposes.
report.term3Text: By uploading photos or media files, you grant CivicPath and the municipal corporation the right to use these images for complaint verification, resolution, and public awareness purposes. Ensure that uploaded images do not contain sensitive personal information of others.
report.term4Text: You agree to receive updates about your complaint via SMS, WhatsApp, or phone calls on the mobile number provided. You may be contacted by municipal officers for additional information or site verification.
report.term5Text: While we strive to resolve all complaints within the specified SLA (Service Level Agreement) timelines, actual resolution time may vary based on the nature and complexity of the issue. You will be notified of any delays.
report.term6Text: The municipal corporation reserves the right to validate, reject, or mark complaints as duplicate if similar issues have already been reported for the same location. You will be notified if your complaint is rejected or marked as duplicate.
report.term7Text: Complaint details (excluding your personal contact information) may be displayed on the public dashboard for transparency and accountability purposes. This includes complaint category, location, status, and resolution details.
report.term8Text: Repeated submission of false complaints, spam, or abusive content may result in blocking of your mobile number from the CivicPath system. Legal action may be taken in cases of severe misuse.
report.term9Text: After complaint resolution, you may be asked to provide feedback on the service quality. Your feedback helps us improve our services and hold departments accountable.
report.term10Text: These terms and conditions may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the CivicPath system constitutes acceptance of any revised terms.
report.termsContact: For questions or concerns, contact: support@civicpath.gov.in
report.agreeCheckbox: I have read and agree to the terms and conditions. I confirm that the information provided is accurate and I understand that my complaint will be processed according to the terms stated above.
report.pleaseAcceptTerms: Please read and accept the terms and conditions to proceed with your complaint submission.
report.contactNote: Your contact information will be used only for updates about this complaint. We respect your privacy and will not share your details with third parties.
